Tess R.: Handing off — seeing a rising 95th latency for hosted text-gen in eu-west1, started ~22:03 UTC. No full outages; error rate still <0.2% but p95 spiked from 180ms → 620ms. Added quick notes below.

oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2241 (eu-west1 latency spike) — severity: medium. Alerts: p95_latency_hosted_gen_eu-west1 > 500ms.

Alex W.: Do we know if this is infra (hosts) or model-side (kv cache misses)?

Sara L.: Initial triage: CPU on some serving pods at 85%, NVidia GPU metric stable. KV cache evictions up slightly after canary; suspect canary rollout touched a model shard with different kv affinity.

Mike D.: Did we roll a new kernel or quantized variant in the canary? Any recent routing policy changes?

Tess R.: Canary rolled at 21:49 UTC (small traffic). Model build v1.12q (quantized), kernel unchanged. I rolled the canary back at 22:10 and gradually routed 10% traffic to fallback model (v1.11q) while enabling dedicated burst in eu-west1.

Alex W.: Nice. Any config commands used so I can reproduce? (or paste in fav runbook snippet)

Tess R.: paste runbook snippet:
```
# route 10% to fallback
redwood route update --region eu-west1 --policy split --weights hosted:v1.11q=10,hosted:v1.12q=90
# enable burst
redwood capacity scale --region eu-west1 --pool dedicated-burst --delta +2
```

Sara L.: Observations after rollback: p95 dipped to ~320ms then hovered. KV warmup continues and misses are trending down. Token cost +4% due to fallback.

Mike D.: If we see error_rate > 1% or p95 > 800ms for 15m, we should trigger full fallback (100% v1.11q) and open postmortem. Also check routing-layer logs for 502s.

Tess R.: Handoff checklist for next shift:
- monitor p95 (hosted_gen eu-west1) and request count
- watch kv_cache_miss_rate and eviction_gauge
- keep canary traffic pinned at 0 until we confirm warmup
- if >1% errors or >800ms p95 for 15m -> full fallback + notify eng-sre
- JIRA INF-3421 created for follow-up: investigate canary shard affinity

Alex W.: Acked, I'll keep an eye for the next hour. ping me if alerts spike. :thumbsup:

Sara L.: I'll follow up on kv eviction tuning in the morning and post notes to #eng-runtime.

Tess R.: Thanks — leaving handoff in Alex's hands. Good luck!

Alex W.: got it, taking over. 2241001299
